title: Use cases: HTTP request, database query and shutdown

videos.script: Two lessons built contexts with nothing real at either end. This one puts them where they were designed to live. {{http}} First, a web request. A client gives up after a tenth of a second. The server notices that the client left, and its handler stops too, instead of finishing a report for nobody. {{database}} Then a database query. This course has no database, and it says so. You see the shape of a query with a deadline, and a program that compiles and fails exactly where the missing driver should be. {{shutdown}} Last, stopping a server politely. A signal arrives while a request is half done. The server shuts its door at once. A late request is refused. The one already inside is answered in full, and only then does the program exit. {{close}} Lesson 13 starts on the patterns: spreading work across goroutines.
